quote: Investors will push for clearer divisions between equity and tokens, but the issue won't be solved in 2026.
author: Mike Ippolito
context: Post 1. Two-part: pressure for clearer equity-vs-token rights, and no resolution within the year.

quote: Several protocols will combine labs and foundations but it won't be the majority yet, although negative stigma will increase around dual structure projects.
author: Mike Ippolito
context: Post 1, second paragraph. Some protocols merge their lab and foundation entities during 2026.

quote: Investor relations will become important. Investors will demand standardized financials, disclosures, etc…
author: Mike Ippolito
context: Post 2. Crypto projects adopt investor-relations practices (standardized financials, disclosures) in 2026.

quote: There will be a push for GAAP style accounting but we won’t get there in 2026.
author: Mike Ippolito
context: Post 3. No GAAP-style accounting standard for crypto protocols is adopted in 2026.

quote: We will see lightweight solutions that provide some standards from data providers.
author: Mike Ippolito
context: Post 3, third paragraph. Data providers (e.g. Token Terminal, Artemis, Blockworks Research) publish protocol financial standards in 2026.

quote: Investors will stop giving credit to highly pro cyclical busineses, and for the first time enterprise software with highly sticky revenue will begin to become “sexy” within crypto.
author: Mike Ippolito
context: Post 4. A valuation shift toward durable revenue within crypto. 'Sexy' is undefined; the bars will need a proxy such as relative multiples or capital raised.

quote: DATs will largely do nothing. Several will make acquisitions around infrastructure (staking, yield generation, asset management, etc…) and attempt to transition into operating companies.
author: Mike Ippolito
context: Post 5. Digital asset treasury companies underperform and several pivot toward operating businesses via acquisitions.

quote: There will be rumblings about labs entities going public, but this won’t take off.
author: Mike Ippolito
context: Post 5, second paragraph. No wave of crypto lab companies going public in 2026.

quote: We'll see real pain in venture capital. Unflattering performance will get reported in media outlets, many will struggle to raise and 2 blue chip funds will close.
author: Mike Ippolito
context: Post 6. The checkable core is two blue-chip crypto VC funds closing (winding down or ceasing new investment) in 2026.

quote: Fintech VCs will enter and outcompete incumbents for attractive later stage deals.
author: Mike Ippolito
context: Post 6, third paragraph. Fintech-focused VCs lead late-stage crypto rounds in 2026.

quote: VC investment will be anemic. Expect a slightly diminished figure from 2025’s $25B, $12-$18B.
author: Mike Ippolito
context: Post 7. Total 2026 crypto venture investment lands between $12B and $18B, down from about $25B in 2025. Numeric; trackers differ (Galaxy, PitchBook, The Block, DefiLlama).

quote: Prediction markets will continue to succeed in 2026, but expect a turn in sentiment. Legal challenges will ramp up and there will be negative press
author: Mike Ippolito
context: Post 8, first part. Prediction markets face escalating legal challenges and negative press in 2026.

quote: despite that volume will continue to climb. Expect 2X from this year’s levels.
author: Mike Ippolito
context: Post 8, second part, split from c12. Prediction-market volume (Polymarket plus Kalshi) in 2026 is about double 2025's.

quote: Kalshi and Polymarket will remain the champs in prediction markets.
author: Mike Ippolito
context: Post 9, first sentence. The two incumbents remain the top two prediction markets by volume through 2026.

quote: Other CEXes will make inroads, Robinhood will continue to succed, Coinbase will fail.
author: Mike Ippolito
context: Post 9, second sentence. Checkable parts: Robinhood's prediction-market business grows; Coinbase's prediction-market effort does not gain traction.

quote: No new startups will be successful, but some sports betting apps will.
author: Mike Ippolito
context: Post 9, third sentence. No new prediction-market startup reaches meaningful volume in 2026, while sportsbooks (DraftKings, FanDuel) launch and gain traction.

quote: Hyperliquid does fine, but growth slows.
author: Mike Ippolito
context: Post 10, first sentence. Hyperliquid's volume or market share growth decelerates in 2026 relative to 2025.

quote: Perps become incredibly competitive, new venues and incumbent CEXes like Coinbase will succeed at eating market share.
author: Mike Ippolito
context: Post 10, second paragraph. Hyperliquid's share of perp volume declines as new venues and CEXes gain.

quote: It will be a difficult year for the protocol and the community will face it's first real sentiment test.
author: Mike Ippolito
context: Post 10, third paragraph. Hyperliquid (HYPE) sentiment turns negative at some point in 2026.

quote: Despite the loud fanfare, equity perps will have a slow start in 2026 but will do better on CEX venues than DEXes. Expect <5% of perp volume by EOY.
author: Mike Ippolito
context: Post 11. Tokenized-equity perpetuals are under 5% of total perp volume at end of 2026, with CEXes ahead of DEXes.

quote: It will be a bad year for Bitcoin sentiment, driven by outperformance in gold, quantum fears, and an overhang from DATs.
author: Mike Ippolito
context: Post 12, first sentence. Bitcoin sentiment is poor in 2026; gold outperforms bitcoin over the year.

quote: Saylor’s reputation will take a hit, and Bitcoin’s weakness about “not being a productive asset” will gain steam again.
author: Mike Ippolito
context: Post 12, second sentence. Michael Saylor / Strategy face reputational damage (e.g. stock underperformance, forced selling, index removal, widespread critical coverage) in 2026.

quote: Quantum is a real threat, and it will get loud this year.
author: Mike Ippolito
context: Post 13, first sentence. Quantum risk to Bitcoin becomes a mainstream crypto narrative in 2026.

quote: Bitcoin core devs will drag their feet, but ultimately come up with a workable solution.
author: Mike Ippolito
context: Post 13, second sentence. A credible post-quantum proposal (BIP or roadmap) for Bitcoin gains broad developer support by end of 2026.

quote: Ethereum will completely reverse sentiment and have its best year since 2021.
author: Mike Ippolito
context: Post 14, first sentence. ETH's 2026 performance (price and sentiment) is its best since 2021.

quote: L1 will have a renaissance in 2026 and largely win the market for RWA issuance.
author: Mike Ippolito
context: Post 14, second sentence. Ethereum mainnet holds the majority of tokenized real-world asset value at end of 2026.

quote: Stablecoin volume will grow slightly, more growth will come from treasuries and new types of RWAs.
author: Mike Ippolito
context: Post 14, third sentence. Stablecoin growth in 2026 is modest while tokenized treasuries and other RWAs grow faster in percentage terms.

quote: RWA looping will become a big trend, but it won’t look like atomic asset looping. Clever protocols will make use of offchain lenders and PBs who act as a bridge.
author: Mike Ippolito
context: Post 15. Leveraged RWA strategies involving off-chain lenders and prime brokers become a notable trend in 2026.

quote: VCs will launch credit funds (which largely won't work), but real credit funds will become more active. They'll act as liquidators for RWAs and vault managers, 2-3 Apollo size funds will make big pushes in.
author: Mike Ippolito
context: Post 16. Two or three large traditional credit managers (Apollo-scale) make major onchain credit moves in 2026.

quote: Vault AUM will grow but not an explosive amount from ~$5B today to $15-20B.
author: Mike Ippolito
context: Post 17. Onchain vault (asset-management) AUM ends 2026 at $15B to $20B, from about $5B at the start of the year.

quote: Morpho and Pendle are the big winners in DeFi.
author: Mike Ippolito
context: Post 18. Morpho and Pendle outperform DeFi peers in 2026 on usage (TVL, volume) and token performance.

quote: Solana has a quiet but successful year.
author: Mike Ippolito
context: Post 19, first sentence. Solana's 2026 is steady: no crisis, continued activity, limited hype.

quote: REV will bottom around mid 2026, and start recovering into year end.
author: Mike Ippolito
context: Post 19, third paragraph. Solana's real economic value (fees plus tips) troughs around mid-2026 and rises in H2.

quote: Passive liquidity provision in AMMs largely dies in 2026, first driven by the success of prop AMMs in Solana.
author: Mike Ippolito
context: Post 20, first sentence. Passive LP share of DEX volume falls sharply in 2026 as proprietary AMMs take share, starting on Solana.

quote: Solana will have a mini crisis around non-meme price discovery not happening on their chain, which will resolve by EOY
author: Mike Ippolito
context: Post 20, second paragraph. A visible debate or crisis about Solana's role in non-memecoin price discovery during 2026.

quote: The new L1 trade is finally dead. The network effects in Ethereum and Solana will become increasingly apparent, which will cause their REV multiple to get rerated (due to being perceived as sticky).
author: Mike Ippolito
context: Post 21. New alt-L1 tokens underperform in 2026 while ETH and SOL multiples on REV expand.

quote: It’s another bad year for onchain infrastructure. Most general purpose L2s or alt L1s completely fail to attract any new users or apps. Expect big pivots or changes in the business model from several large protocols by EOY.
author: Mike Ippolito
context: Post 22. Several large infrastructure protocols announce pivots or business-model changes during 2026.

quote: Infrastructure will go through massive consolidation. L2 frameworks, RaaS, shared sequencing, etc… all compress into one category. These move from being thought of as ecosystems to CoSS, similar to Redhat. 2-3 vertically integrated solutions will emerge and do well.
author: Mike Ippolito
context: Post 23. Consolidation (mergers, acquisitions, shutdowns) among L2 frameworks and rollup-as-a-service providers in 2026.

quote: Tempo will debut to fanfare and strong initial metrics but slowly bleed
author: Mike Ippolito
context: Post 24. Tempo (the Stripe and Paradigm payments chain) launches in 2026 with strong early metrics that then decline.

quote: Arc will fail to gain adoption
author: Mike Ippolito
context: Post 24, split from c39. Circle's Arc chain has little usage in 2026.

quote: Robinhood Chain will start on a similar trajectory to Base.
author: Mike Ippolito
context: Post 24, split from c39. Robinhood Chain launches in 2026 and grows quickly, comparably to Base's first year.

quote: 4-5 new chains will get announced, Blackrock is one of them.
author: Mike Ippolito
context: Post 24, split from c39. Four or five new corporate chains are announced in 2026, including one by BlackRock.

quote: Base will begin to come under some amount of scrutiny after having largely been assumed to win the L2 war in 2025. The content coin push will fail, and there will be an existential crisis around not winning any category.
author: Mike Ippolito
context: Post 25. Base faces criticism in 2026 and its content-coin initiative fails to gain traction.

quote: Privacy will begin to get introduced and pushed via the corporate chain layer. The winning argument will come from financial institutions making a business case, not cypherpunk ideology.
author: Mike Ippolito
context: Post 26, first part. Corporate or institutional chains ship privacy features in 2026.

quote: Most existing solutions will not do well, ZEC was a one off and will have a bad 2026.
author: Mike Ippolito
context: Post 26, second part, split from c44. Zcash (ZEC) underperforms in 2026 after its late-2025 rally.

quote: Agentic commerce within crypto will be just above a bagel on the year. Expect almost no real volume or traction in crypto agentic commerce until better data, controls and provenance become widespread and in place.
author: Mike Ippolito
context: Post 27. Crypto agentic-commerce volume (e.g. x402, agent payments) stays negligible through 2026.
